entities.summary: Chan Chun Sing is a Singaporean politician and former major-general who is serving as Coordinating Minister for Public Services and Minister for Defence since 2025. A member of the governing People's Action Party (PAP), he has been the Member of Parliament (MP) for the Buona Vista division of Tanjong Pagar Group Representation Constituency (GRC) since 2011.
